item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Houthis say they attacked power plant, port in Saudi Arabia
item.description: According to Yahya Saria, the strikes that caused serious damage came as response to the Saudi-led coalition’s strikes against on power plants in the Yemeni cities of Saada and Mokha, and the shelling attack on a Hodeida port berth

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Russia boosts production of new weapons, deputy defense minister says
item.description: Yunus-Bek Yevkurov added that the Defense Ministry, together with federal agencies and regional authorities, was "actively implementing a wide range of social support measures for veterans of the special military operation and their families"

item.title: Meduza: A plaque honoring Felix Dzerzhinsky goes up in central Moscow. It calls him an ‘outstanding statesman’ and credits him with launching industrialization.
item.description: The Moscow city government and the FSB’s Public Council have installed a bronze plaque honoring Felix Dzerzhinsky in Slavyanskaya Square, TASS reported.

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): US tells EU, Ukraine it wants to see peace deal by early January — media
item.description: According to the newspaper, the White House hopes to secure a deal before Democrats take control of the US Congress

item.title: Meduza: Trump says Putin launched a couple of small missiles into Poland by accident — ‘a couple of little missiles’
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump spoke to Fox News about the breach of Polish airspace by Russian missiles and drones during an overnight attack on Ukraine.

item.title: Meduza: Estonia to close all road crossings with Russia
item.description: Estonia’s government has decided to temporarily close its road border crossings with Russia starting December 1, citing national security.

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Russia to respond to Denmark’s expulsion of military attache — diplomat
item.description: Earlier, the Danish Foreign Ministry summoned Russian Ambassador to Copenhagen Vladimir Barbin and informed him that a Russian military attache had been declared persona non grata

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Israeli troops shell Lebanese villages north of Litani River — agency
item.description: According to the agency, coming under shelling were the villages of Bani Hayyan, Zawtar al-Sharqiyah, Mayfadoun, Sarbin, and al-Ghandouriyah in the Nabatieh province north of the Litani River

item.title: Meduza: Germany’s defense minister urges Europe to take up Putin’s offer of talks in Moscow. Radio Liberty reports the trip could happen as early as November.
item.description: Europeans should accept Russian President Vladimir Putin’s invitation to come to Moscow for talks, German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius said.

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Estonia inflames already strained ties with Russia and Baltic region overall — diplomat
item.description: Estonia’s decision to unilaterally close the remaining border crossing points with Russia is a provocative move, Maria Zakharova said

item.title: Meduza: Russia’s deputy prime minister says Crimean Bridge arch and main girder are damaged and repair timeline is unclear
item.description: Russia’s deputy prime minister, Marat Khusnullin, said it was still unclear how long repairs to the Crimean Bridge would take. He said officials could estimate the duration once engineers provided plans for the repairs.

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Denmark to restrict visa issuance to Russians — foreign minister
item.description: Lars Lokke Rasmussen noted that the restrictions would apply to visas for non-urgent, nonessential travel and urged EU countries to follow suit

item.title: Meduza: Ukraine clause dropped from Trump, Putin, and Xi’s ‘peace declaration’ at U.S. request, Finland’s president says
item.description: At Washington’s request, a provision on Ukraine was dropped from the “peace declaration” that U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin adopted at the close of their summit, Finnish President Alexander Stubb said.

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Jet fuel situation in Russia normal — Deputy PM
item.description: The Energy Ministry will decide on the renewal of the export ban, Andrey Nikitin said

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Russian envoy to EU reiterates call for Western diplomats to leave Kiev
item.description: Karen Malayan said that the Russian Armed Forces continue to carry out systematic strikes on Ukrainian military facilities in retaliation for the Ukrainian military’s terrorist activities targeting civilians and civilian infrastructure in Russia

item.title: Meduza: Poland issues air raid alerts as Russia attacks Ukraine. Poland’s defense minister says two Russian missiles and a drone fell on Polish soil.
item.description: Air raid alerts went out in two Polish provinces bordering Ukraine as Russia attacked Ukraine overnight into November 20.

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Tallinn uses Russia border closure for military, political ends — expert
item.description: These measures are a blow to everyone who maintains human and business ties with Russia, Natalya Yeryomina said

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Netherlands unconvincingly denies role in Ukraine conflict, Russian diplomat says
item.description: Dmitry Polyansky said he asked the Dutch representative at a meeting of the OSCE Permanent Council whether the use of Destinus drones by Ukrainian forces meant that the Netherlands was openly joining the conflict in Ukraine

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Bitcoin drops below $60,000 — market data
item.description: The cryptocurrency lost 5.75% to $59,411

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): Missile strikes outskirts of Iranian city of Qeshm — agency
item.description: No details were provided on possible damage or the scale of the attack

item.title: TASS (Russian state media): British general confirms UK cyber operations against Russia, China
item.description: General Sir Rob Magowan believes that Russia, China, Iran and North Korea pose "a threat to the way of life"
